recipes.story: From Armenia it runs 350 km to Armenia; allow about 7 h 01 of riding. The stops in between: Cultural Landscape of Colombia, Zone B and back through  Cultural Landscape of Colombia. The stored terrain estimate reaches about 2,450 m; a measured road-elevation profile is not available. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
